narrative.intro: Mistral’s federal contracting in FY2026 to date centers on large, defense-oriented awards. The Department of Defense obligated $213M across 9 awards, producing an average award size of $23.7M and driving obligations up 384.3% year over year. Prior fiscal years show a clear build: FY21 had $224K, FY22 had $39.4K, FY24 had $727K, and FY25 had $44M. Other federal buyers are small by comparison: the Department of Justice obligated $7.4K. Industry concentration is strong: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing accounts for $191M in obligations, followed by Aircraft Manufacturing at $22.5M. Smaller NAICS entries include Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals. Award-value and expiring-contract listings use total contract values where noted in award tables and contracting reports.

sections.heading: Who is buying from Mistral and in what amounts?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $213M, making DOD the dominant buyer. The Department of Justice appears as a minor buyer with $7.4K. No other agencies are listed among the top buyers for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What product and industry markets drive Mistral’s federal business?
sections.body: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing is the largest market at $191M. Aircraft Manufacturing follows at $22.5M, with smaller activity in Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K.

faq.q: How much does Mistral make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Mistral has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company recorded 9 awards with an average award size of $23.7M and obligations up 384.3% year over year. Prior fiscal-year obligations were FY21: $224K, FY22: $39.4K, FY24: $727K, and FY25: $44M.
The Department of Defense buys from Mistral and obligated $213M in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice also bought from Mistral and obligated $7.4K.

faq.q: What does Mistral sell to the government?
faq.a: Mistral sells guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment, which is the largest market at $191M. Mistral also supplies aircraft manufacturing products at $22.5M and smaller services or equipment in commercial and industrial machinery repair at $15.1K and irradiation apparatus manufacturing at $7.4K.
